subheader: and the role sits below it
bodytext:
One person in full: a portrait beside a rich-text biography. The name goes in the header field, not in the text. That way the page module, the search index and shared links all show a person's name.

The biography is the only rich-text field. Lines stop at about 62 characters at any band width, so the text stays easy to read.

Up to two links close the column: one to contact the person, one to their work. The reverse switch moves the portrait to the other side, and the name is still read first.
